verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is a fully open-source framework distributed via apt/source with no cloud dependency, installable and run entirely on user-owned infrastructure (ROS-Base and Desktop install options, CLI tools, client libraries). Community evidence confirms it is widely self-hosted in production and research despite operational complaints. missing for 10: no explicit first-party 'self-hosting' guide or containerized deployment reference architecture, and no independent audit confirming zero external calls.
